newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's Prime Minister leaves for G-15 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's Prime Minister leaves for G-15 meeting.

text.p: Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia left Algiers for the Zimbabwean capital Harare on Saturday to attend a Group of 15 (G-15) summit to boost trade among developing countries, Algerian state-run radio said.
The organisers of the summit say eight heads of state and government have confirmed their attendance at the November 3 to 5 meeting.
The leaders will look at ways of forging a common front among African, Asian and Latin American states to give them a stronger voice in a world moving towards free trade.
Algeria is a founder member of the Group of 15 which also includes Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Malaysia, Nigeria, Senegal, Peru, Venezuela, Yugoslavia and Zimbabwe.
